prompt: Every hour, for as long as the cell stays in service, have arm1 inspect box1 on the shelf with camera_top.
why: Recurring, open-ended repetition. RoboLang 1.3 has no loop, no schedule and no clock; only a fixed, finite plan can be written (a fixed count could be unrolled, but "as long as the cell is in service" is not a count).
